status_history.note: Reopened from Completed by the honest-status audit: the evidence fails the task's own criteria. See blockers.

blockers.description: Reopen evidence: Railway production, read 2026-10-05 via the Railway API: every service (api, ai-worker, events-worker, ingestion-worker, notifications-worker) has `OTEL_ENABLED=false` and no `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT`; `ws` has no OTel vars. `infra/terraform/environments/production/terraform.tfvars` keeps OTel off until `otel_exporter_endpoint` is set, and it is not set. Production exports no traces, metrics or logs.

Reopen evidence: `artifacts/misc/trace-examples.json` declares `"exporter": "InMemorySpanExporter"` (from `tools/scripts/observability/capture-trace-examples.ts`). The DoD requires "real trace IDs from actual service calls, not fabricated examples". In-process test spans do not meet that, and GATE:real-trace-data / GATE:integration-wired cannot pass while production export is off.
Reopen evidence: KPI "alerts configured": the four ifc032 rules have never been loaded by an alerting system connected to production. The only stack that ran was a local Docker compose with no SMTP.

To close: (1) Choose a hosted OTLP backend and set `otel_exporter_endpoint` plus its auth for the Railway api and workers (Terraform/env PR; secrets only in Railway/GitHub secrets). (2) Load the four ifc032 alert rules, plus API error rate and availability, into that backend with a contact point the owner receives. Prove it with a test alert. (3) Replace the `trace-examples.json` evidence with at least one trace ID from a real production request, visible in the backend. Closing requires production evidence (configured endpoint, real trace ID, received alert); local, in-memory or template artifacts do not count.
